title: kid placement
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; HCERT Specification, 3.2.3 Key Identifier. QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “verifiers MUST accept both placements — but when it appears in both, the protected one wins.”.

statements.label: kid placement
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL put alg and kid in the protected header. The verifier SHALL accept a kid in either the protected or the unprotected header, and SHALL use the protected one when both are present.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-COS-003 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-COS-001 STT-COS-003 a tagged COSE_Sign1 with alg and kid in the protected header` (SignCoseTest.kt)).
